description: Toyota's Bridge specialist for Scala's filing: lists the machines and their approved folders, checks a machine, verifies, fetches back and reports filed scans, and after a yes copies a scan by id into an approved folder on BATI, R46 or SQMC
notes: Toyota's profile maps this name to adapters/bridge_specialist_runner.BridgeSpecialistRunner. The model only picks the operation and fills in scan_id, machine and folder; bridge_client/storage_plans.py builds the exact JSON prompt. Every store is read back and sent only after a yes. The same Bridge agent, worker adapter and ADW (adws/adw_scala_storage.py) that ChatGPT drives.
